title: Nice experience
text: It is good, you learn a lot and the guide has a lot of knowledge.  They are punctual and give you time to take photos!

title: Unforgettable experience
text: Highly recommended, Fernando our guide, spectacular. There were only 2 of us Spaniards and the rest were English, and his handling of explaining everything in both languages was perfect.
author: Jose_E

title: Such an amazing experience
text: Hector with granavision was simply amazing. He made us feel like we were transported back in time, he had a wealth of knowledge, perfect English, it was like having a multi cultural and lingual historian taking us around. 100/10 recommend.

title: Alain our guide was great
text:
Alain our guide was fantastic - very kind, informative and a marvellous sense of humour in 3 languages!!!  Well done

The tour was wonderful Alain pointed out many points of interest as well as informed historical information and facts 

Thank you for a great time
